value.rationale: The maximum mutually orthogonal normalized kernel evaluations is a canonical finite coherent-sampling invariant. Finding its exact fourth-order value exposes a surprising failure of monotonicity under inclusion of full order-three into full order-four polyanalytic Fock Hilbert spaces, whose normalized evaluation geometry changes with the norm. The result settles the complete planar exact-orthogonality configuration problem at this order, and its cyclic-cubic modular distance obstruction has a generalizable approach. It is not an arbitrary numeric slice or mere rounded calculation.
